      "evidence": "Labeled RPC/REST/ZMQ; modifies src/rpc/net.cpp to add cpu_load to getpeerinfo and updates bitcoin-cli -netinfo.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Adds a normalized cpu_load metric to getpeerinfo and bitcoin-cli -netinfo to help operators monitor peer resource usage. Reviewers note its diagnostic value during DoS investigation, but new exploratory metrics without explicit external consumer demand are P3."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Adds thread CPU timing implementations in src/util/time.h and src/util/time.cpp.",

      "score": 0.3,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "Introduces cross-platform thread CPU timing utilities using clock_gettime on POSIX and GetThreadTimes on Windows. The utilities are a clean, functional addition to the time library, but represent incremental internal infrastructure."
